content: SwiftUI .slide only works in one direction; use .asymmetric(insertion:removal:) with .move(edge:) pairs to get direction-aware transitions, and the direction must be computed from the enum ordering / previous-vs-new segment, not hardcoded. No native support for cross-fading structurally different containers (List vs ScrollView) -- community pattern is to overlay/snapshot or unify both branches under one container type to avoid layout jumps.
